A '''Tripod Tension Adjust''' was a component on the [[TR-62 Autocushion Tripod/Legends|TR-62 Autocushion Tripod]]. It was located at the point where the [[Tripod (weapon attachment)/Legends|tripod]] connected to the main body of the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]], below the [[Magnetic clamp/Legends|magnetic clamp]].<ref name="EGWT" />
